skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand and apply modern teaching methods for English, including task-based and communicative language teaching.
Design lesson plans and teaching materials for English language learners.
Develop and implement effective assessment methods for evaluating English language proficiency.
Manage classroom activities and interactions effectively.
Work collaboratively with peers in group activities and discussions.
Demonstrate professional conduct and teaching demeanor.
Analyze and evaluate teaching methods and materials critically.
Communicate effectively in English, both verbally and in writing.
Apply various instructional techniques for teaching vocabulary, grammar, and language skills.
Utilize educational technology to enhance teaching and learning.
